headline: Exchanges Take In $1,259.8 Million As Coins Arrive On Venues
narrative: Crypto exchanges took in $1,259.8 million over 24 hours, equal to 0.4689 percent of reserves, a heavy inflow as coins arrived on trading venues. Bitcoin exchange reserves rose 28,547.68 coins over seven days to 1,276,226.39, the 96.7 percentile of the past 30 days, coins arriving on exchanges. Cumulative volume delta printed -218.01, the 23.7 percentile of the past 30 days and sell-side leaning, while bitcoin changed hands near 80k.
author: jordan
